answer: Every unique AI identity requires an irreversible 1,000 unit burn, verified by scanning the public chain for an unspent transaction hash. This vine of expense prevents mass duplication since each receipt acts as an exclusive nullifier. An honest entity pays 1,000 units for entry, while an attacker seeking 1,000 identities must burn 1,000,000 units. The system lacks any wharf for liquidity extraction or refunds. At the nadir of protocol efficiency, the sunk cost makes sybil creation economically irrational, as parallel execution does not amortize the mandatory per-head token destruction.
